title: Master secret to sender/recipient keys
notes: Verified RFC 8613 section 3.2.1 master-secret derivation end to end: HKDF-SHA-256, empty salt default, role-specific Sender/Recipient IDs, absent-vs-present ID Context CBOR semantics, AES-CCM-16-64-128 key length 16 and common IV length 13. Canonical C.1-C.3 vectors directly match Python and the Rust production dependency; C.4-C.6 byte-exact protection plus cross-exchange vectors prove wrapper parity without exposing key material. No EDHOC or C/Zephyr changes required. Gates: Python crypto 401 passed/2 xpassed; direct Rust RFC KDF test passed; lichen-oscore all-features 21 passed/1 ignored; no_std check, clippy -D warnings, rustfmt, ruff, mypy, JSON schema all pass. Mechanical gate fixes only: annotate untyped aiocoap Message import for mypy and rustfmt accumulated vector-test hunks.
